title: Simultaneous Honest Bands for Pairwise Factorial Effects under Weak Assignment Support
banked_reason: D0.5 typed BELOW NOVELTY FLOOR: delivered tier incremental < floor field; heterogeneous Gamma(K) converse remains open; four panel findings were unrepaired after novelty triage.
gap_reasons: The requested equal-cell rate of order min{1, sqrt(log(eM)/(n rho^2))} is proved only for the different assignment-law estimand and for the balanced equal-cell design; the rare-cell construction shows that this headline is false for general unequal equal-cell weighting.

For heterogeneous assignment, the delivered result is an upper bound paired with four lower certificates that are not shown comparable, while the load-bearing Gamma(K(p)) multiscale converse remains open.

The advertised design-specific feasible band is not directly usable because C_infty is only ‘large enough’ rather than a supplied numerical calibration or an evaluable cited calibration rule; state one valid value/construction.

The note candidly calls its kernel an incremental product-Bernoulli coefficient specialization, but it does not compare the rare-cell expected-maximum-width result with the closest generic finite-dictionary/orthogonal-coefficient honest-rectangle theorem; the unresolved literature audit prevents a theorem-level novelty finding.

The sole theorem matching the requested assignment-law minimax rate says only ‘by a Bernstein band’; its actual interval center and radius are buried in proof_tex, so lift that computable procedure and its uniform-honesty statement into the proposition/estimand-functional presentation.

Most listed factorial, simultaneous-interval, and confidence-set references receive no theorem-specific relevance/comparison sentence, and the many ‘unmatched’ comparator rows do not explain precisely why their result classes fail to cover the four-endpoint bracket.
proof_attempt_summary: D0 derived a finite-sample equal-cell band and four all-procedure lower certificates under product-Bernoulli assignment; the math referee passed the checked claims and verified all cited statements. D0.5 novelty triage stopped at incremental below the field floor because the heterogeneous multiscale converse remained open and the originally advertised rho-only equal-cell rate is false under unequal assignment. The decision panel had four unrepaired findings on evaluation-map placement, numerical calibration, closest-literature audit, and positioning; this bank is a stopped research record, not a fully cleared paper or Lean formalization.
tldr: For the equal-cell vector of all pairwise causal differences-in-differences under known independent Bernoulli assignment, the centered importance score yields a finite-sample honest band governed by the exact covariance metric \(d_K\) and exact bounded-increment metric \(d_\infty\). The all-procedure lower bracket is now \(\max\{A(p)/20,\Lambda_{n,p}/50,\Psi_{n,p}/200,\Omega_{n,p}/20\}\), where \(\Omega_{n,p}\) detects unions of rare assignment cells. For homogeneous assignment it gives \(W^*\ge(1/10)\min\{1,[n\{4q(1-q)\}^{k/2}]^{-1/2}\}\); at \(q=0.1\) and \(n\asymp1.5^k\) this stays constant although the three older lower scales vanish. At balance the rate remains \(\min\{1,\sqrt{\log(eM)/n}\}\); a full heterogeneous multiscale \(\Gamma(K(p))\) converse remains open.
gap: Product-Bernoulli factorial design theory optimizes truncated-OLS mean-squared error under bounded-degree interactions, causal factorial theory fixes estimands through weighting, Gaussian interaction-contrast theory compares simultaneous interval constructions, and vector off-policy theory gives fixed-accuracy or asymptotic simultaneous guarantees. None treats an unrestricted binary response surface and derives the exact equal-cell pair-weight Gram together with a matching all-procedure expected maximum-width frontier.
fill: The project derives the exact known second-moment Gram matrix, constructs a centered band calibrated against its positive-semidefinite envelope with an explicit finite-sample remainder, proves an all-procedure lower bound using Bernoulli response-surface perturbations in the same geometry, and turns the homogeneous design into a three-component phase diagram.
